card.name: The P in USP standards
card.fires_on: The letter P completing the abbreviation USP (United States Pharmacopeia) in label text, e.g. USP Controlled Room Temperature or USP Type 1 glass. Also fires weakly on plastic abbreviations like PC.

modes.label: USP abbreviation
modes.description: The P ending USP before a standard term such as Controlled Room Temperature, Type 1 glass, or isopropyl alcohol.

modes.label: Plastic material names
modes.description: A weaker response in lists of plastics or extraction from PVC, such as PC or the word from.
modes.example: Two sterile syringes (PP,<< PC>> or glass)

card.plain: It marks the last letter of USP, the pharmacopeia standard named in storage and material instructions.
